## Status

Status is a declared field. Authors set it. It is not inferred from git or CI.

<div class="entity-table">
<table>
<thead>
<tr><th>Value</th><th>Kind</th><th>Meaning</th></tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr><td data-label="Value"><code>queued</code></td><td data-label="Kind">live</td><td data-label="Meaning">Committed. Not started.</td></tr>
<tr><td data-label="Value"><code>active</code></td><td data-label="Kind">live</td><td data-label="Meaning">Work is in progress.</td></tr>
<tr><td data-label="Value"><code>specced</code></td><td data-label="Kind">live</td><td data-label="Meaning">A spec exists. Requires directive.spec.</td></tr>
<tr><td data-label="Value"><code>done</code></td><td data-label="Kind">terminal</td><td data-label="Meaning">Implementation complete and the gate passed. Requires directive.spec and directive.completed.</td></tr>
<tr><td data-label="Value"><code>replaced</code></td><td data-label="Kind">terminal</td><td data-label="Meaning">A named successor took over. Requires replaced-by.</td></tr>
<tr><td data-label="Value"><code>canceled</code></td><td data-label="Kind">terminal</td><td data-label="Meaning">Abandoned.</td></tr>
</tbody>
</table>
</div>

<div class="entity-illegal">
<p>Illegal</p>
<ul>
<li>Any other status name</li>
<li><code>replaced</code> without <code>replaced-by</code></li>
<li>A directive with an empty source list</li>
<li>Priority as a field on the directive</li>
</ul>
</div>

## Constraints

- Position in BACKLOG.yml is priority
- Every directive cites at least one source
- A directive is not a path into implementation

## Validate

<pre><code>backstop artifact validate --directive DIR-NNN</code></pre>

## Reviewer

Directives do not have a dedicated reviewer agent.

- The validator checks source, status gates, and retirement fields

## Notes

Directives form the backlog. They are not a substitute for a plan.

Feature work still uses bundle → spec → plan. Bounded work still uses issue → plan.
